choose.q: How do I choose a course?
choose.a: Open the catalog and compare duration, level and price. If you are unsure, tell the assistant your goal and it will suggest a suitable course.

source.q: Where does the assistant get its answers?
source.a: From the school’s materials: course programs, prices and teacher descriptions. If the answer is not in the materials, the assistant says so.

languages.q: Which languages does the site support?
languages.a: Russian, Uzbek and English. Switch the language in the site header.

prices.q: Where can I see the prices?
prices.a: In the “Course prices” section, which lists the price of every course in the catalog
